arguments.title: Formspec Cloud
arguments.brief: Managed hosted-forms and signature SaaS. Customer and administrator work stays in the app; public respondents use a short mobile-first flow. Every exposed capability is live, assisted, preview, or disabled.

binding.content: LIVE — Workspace summary: published forms, recent responses, signature status, and plan usage. Navigation: Forms, Responses, Signatures, Integrations, Administration, Billing, Support.
LIVE — Create organization, workspace, production and sandbox environments, and invite a teammate. SSO/SAML/SCIM is ASSISTED with visible request status.
LIVE — Create from curated template or import Studio output; publish, share, pin a version, and set basic branding. Collaborative authoring is PREVIEW.
LIVE — Draft and published version, hosted link, share controls, response count, owner notices, and PDF status for selected tenant formId.
PREVIEW — Check public mobile layout, validation, review, and confirmation before publishing; production submissions remain unavailable until publication.
LIVE — View tenant responses, export CSV/JSON, and fetch receipts, certificates, and verifier-backed proof status. Bulk export packages are ASSISTED.
LIVE — Send basic envelopes, view signer status, remind, complete, and retrieve certificates. Enhanced identity proofing, witness/notary, and bulk send are DISABLED.
LIVE — API keys, generated API docs, sandbox/test mode, one webhook target, and delivery history. Connectors and workflow-initiated intake are PREVIEW; large imports are ASSISTED.

LIVE — Organization, workspaces, roles, invitations, branding, and feature-state visibility. Custom domains, advanced retention/legal hold, and regulated posture review are ASSISTED. DSAR self-service is DISABLED.
LIVE — Plan limits, usage, billing status, and entitlements. Availability reflects entitlement, feature state, deployment profile, and adapter health.
LIVE — Status for form runtime, proof, email, and webhooks; support and incident records; trust center and subprocessors. Dedicated review is ASSISTED; multi-region active-active is DISABLED.
LIVE — Anonymous mobile-first completion with validation, review, submission, notifications, and confirmation. No respondent account or dashboard is required.
LIVE — Submission receipt and verifier-backed proof status. Hosted general-purpose verification is DISABLED; the documented CLI/library path remains available.
